source: User CExit photographs, all three pages, and confirmation of normal return/menus/crown
interpretation: Stage12 identifies write(command7 release-image) refusal, errno16. CExit stops and never advances to JOIN/rmmod. Displayed state is the last valid pre-command snapshot, not a post-failure re-read. With started1/joined0, image_ref busy is the direct native candidate, but actual image_close callbacks/cookie validity/reader liveness were not observed.
